parameters.content: ## Create subscription\nAuthorize, load restaurant, resolve customer, create subscription, persist billing state, respond.

parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json;if(input.halt){return $input.all();}const restaurantId=input.request_body.restaurant_id??input.request_query.restaurant_id;const email=input.request_body.email;const planType=input.request_body.plan_type;const priceMap={starter:$env.STRIPE_PRICE_STARTER,pro:$env.STRIPE_PRICE_PRO,business:$env.STRIPE_PRICE_BUSINESS};const priceId=input.request_body.price_id??priceMap[planType];const allowedPlans=new Set(['starter','pro','business']);if(!restaurantId||!email||!planType||!allowedPlans.has(planType)||!priceId){return [{json:{...input,halt:true,restaurant_id:restaurantId??null,body:{error:'invalid_configuration',message:'restaurant_id, email, plan_type, and price_id are required'}}}];}return [{json:{...input,restaurant_id:restaurantId,email,plan_type:planType,price_id:priceId}}];

const input=$('Validate Create Subscription Request').first().json;if(input.body?.error){return [{json:input}];}const restaurant=$input.first().json;if(!restaurant?.id){return [{json:{...input,body:{error:'not_found',message:'Restaurant not found'}}}];}return [{json:{...input,restaurant}}];
const input=$('Normalize Create Subscription Restaurant').first().json;const customer=$input.first().json;return [{json:{...input,stripe_customer_id:customer.id}}];

const subscription=$('HTTP Create Stripe Subscription').first().json;const createContext=$('HTTP Create Stripe Subscription').item.json;const clientSecret=subscription.latest_invoice?.confirmation_secret?.client_secret??subscription.pending_setup_intent?.client_secret??subscription.latest_invoice?.payment_intent?.client_secret??null;const autoCharged=!clientSecret&&['active','trialing'].includes(subscription.status);return [{json:{clientSecret,subscriptionId:subscription.id,customerId:createContext.stripe_customer_id,autoCharged}}];

parameters.content: ## Change subscription\nAuthorize, load restaurant, read current subscription, change price, persist, respond.

parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json;if(input.halt){return $input.all();}const restaurantId=input.request_body.restaurant_id??input.request_query.restaurant_id;const targetPlanType=input.request_body.target_plan_type??input.request_body.plan_type;const priceMap={starter:$env.STRIPE_PRICE_STARTER,pro:$env.STRIPE_PRICE_PRO,business:$env.STRIPE_PRICE_BUSINESS};const targetPriceId=input.request_body.target_price_id??input.request_body.price_id??priceMap[targetPlanType];const allowedPlans=new Set(['starter','pro','business']);if(!restaurantId||!targetPlanType||!allowedPlans.has(targetPlanType)||!targetPriceId){return [{json:{...input,halt:true,restaurant_id:restaurantId??null,body:{error:'invalid_configuration',message:'restaurant_id, target_plan_type, and target_price_id are required'}}}];}return [{json:{...input,restaurant_id:restaurantId,target_plan_type:targetPlanType,target_price_id:targetPriceId}}];

const input=$('Validate Change Subscription Request').first().json;if(input.body?.error){return [{json:input}];}const restaurant=$input.first().json;if(!restaurant?.id){return [{json:{...input,body:{error:'not_found',message:'Restaurant not found'}}}];}if(!restaurant.stripe_subscription_id){return [{json:{...input,body:{error:'invalid_configuration',message:'Restaurant does not have an active Stripe subscription'}}}];}return [{json:{...input,restaurant}}];

const subscription=$('HTTP Change Stripe Subscription').first().json;const context=$('Normalize Change Subscription Restaurant').first().json;return [{json:{subscriptionId:subscription.id,plan_type:context.target_plan_type,status:'updated',autoCharged:true}}];

parameters.content: ## Cancel subscription\nAuthorize, load restaurant, cancel in Stripe, persist cancellation, respond.

parameters.jsCode: const input=$('Validate Cancel Subscription Request').first().json;if(input.body?.error){return [{json:input}];}const restaurant=$input.first().json;if(!restaurant?.id){return [{json:{...input,body:{error:'not_found',message:'Restaurant not found'}}}];}if(!restaurant.stripe_subscription_id){return [{json:{...input,body:{error:'invalid_configuration',message:'Restaurant does not have a Stripe subscription to cancel'}}}];}return [{json:{...input,restaurant}}];

const subscription=$('HTTP Cancel Stripe Subscription').first().json;return [{json:{subscriptionId:subscription.id ?? $('Normalize Cancel Subscription Restaurant').first().json.restaurant.stripe_subscription_id,status:'canceled'}}];

parameters.content: ## Subscription status\nAuthorize, load restaurant, return current billing state.

parameters.jsCode: const input=$('Validate Subscription Status Request').first().json;if(input.body?.error){return [{json:input.body}];}const restaurant=$input.first().json;if(!restaurant?.id){return [{json:{error:'not_found',message:'Restaurant not found'}}];}return [{json:{plan_type:restaurant.plan_type,plan_status:restaurant.plan_status,trial_ends_at:restaurant.trial_ends_at,stripe_customer_id:restaurant.stripe_customer_id,stripe_subscription_id:restaurant.stripe_subscription_id,billing_last_error:restaurant.billing_last_error,subscription_canceled_at:restaurant.subscription_canceled_at}}];

parameters.content: ## Stripe webhook\nVerify signature, normalize event, load restaurant, persist audit event, update restaurant billing state, respond.

parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json;const webhookSecret=$env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET;const signatureHeader=input.request_headers['stripe-signature']??input.request_headers['Stripe-Signature'];const rawBody=typeof input.raw_body==='string'?input.raw_body:JSON.stringify(input.request_body??{});if(!webhookSecret){return [{json:{body:{error:'invalid_configuration',message:'Missing Stripe webhook signing secret'}}}];}if(!signatureHeader){return [{json:{body:{error:'unauthorized',message:'Missing Stripe signature header'}}}];}const crypto=require('crypto');const signatureParts={};for(const segment of String(signatureHeader).split(',')){const [key,...rest]=segment.split('=');if(key&&rest.length){signatureParts[key]=signatureParts[key]??[];signatureParts[key].push(rest.join('='));}}const timestamp=signatureParts.t?.[0];const signatures=signatureParts.v1??[];if(!timestamp||signatures.length===0){return [{json:{body:{error:'unauthorized',message:'Malformed Stripe signature header'}}}];}const toleranceSeconds=Number($env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_TOLERANCE_SECONDS??300);const ageSeconds=Math.abs(Math.floor(Date.now()/1000)-Number(timestamp));const expected=crypto.createHmac('sha256',webhookSecret).update(`${timestamp}.${rawBody}`,'utf8').digest('hex');const expectedBuffer=Buffer.from(expected,'utf8');const valid=signatures.some((signature)=>{const receivedBuffer=Buffer.from(signature,'utf8');return receivedBuffer.length===expectedBuffer.length&&crypto.timingSafeEqual(receivedBuffer,expectedBuffer);});if(!valid||ageSeconds>toleranceSeconds){return [{json:{body:{error:'unauthorized',message:'Invalid Stripe signature'}}}];}let event;try{event=JSON.parse(rawBody);}catch{return [{json:{body:{error:'invalid_configuration',message:'Unable to parse Stripe webhook payload'}}}];}const supported=new Set(['invoice.paid','customer.subscription.updated','customer.subscription.deleted']);if(!supported.has(event.type)){return [{json:{skip:true,body:{received:true,handled:false,reason:'unsupported_event',event_type:event.type,event_id:event.id}}}];}const object=event.data?.object??{};return [{json:{event,event_type:event.type,provider_event_id:event.id,stripe_customer_id:object.customer??null,stripe_subscription_id:object.subscription??object.id??null,payload:event}}];

const context=$('Verify Stripe Webhook').first().json;const rows=$input.first().json;const restaurant=Array.isArray(rows)?rows[0]:(rows?.data?.[0]??rows?.[0]??null);if(!restaurant?.id){return [{json:{body:{error:'not_found',message:'Restaurant not found for Stripe event'}}}];}const object=context.event.data?.object??{};const latestPriceId=object.items?.data?.[0]?.price?.id??object.lines?.data?.[0]?.price?.id??null;const priceMap=new Map([[$env.STRIPE_PRICE_STARTER,'starter'],[$env.STRIPE_PRICE_PRO,'pro'],[$env.STRIPE_PRICE_BUSINESS,'business']].filter(([priceId])=>Boolean(priceId)));const resolvedPlanType=object.metadata?.plan_type??(latestPriceId?priceMap.get(latestPriceId):undefined)??restaurant.plan_type;const sourceStatus=object.status??(context.event_type==='invoice.paid'?'active':restaurant.plan_status);const normalizedPlanStatus=sourceStatus==='active'?'active':sourceStatus==='trialing'?'trialing':sourceStatus==='canceled'?'canceled':sourceStatus==='unpaid'||sourceStatus==='incomplete_expired'?'expired':sourceStatus==='past_due'?'active':sourceStatus==='incomplete'?(restaurant.plan_status??'trialing'):restaurant.plan_status;const trialEndsAt=object.trial_end?new Date(Number(object.trial_end)*1000).toISOString():restaurant.trial_ends_at??null;const canceledAt=sourceStatus==='canceled'?(object.canceled_at?new Date(Number(object.canceled_at)*1000).toISOString():restaurant.subscription_canceled_at??new Date().toISOString()):null;return [{json:{...context,restaurant,resolved_plan_type:resolvedPlanType,normalized_plan_status:normalizedPlanStatus,resolved_trial_ends_at:trialEndsAt,resolved_subscription_canceled_at:canceledAt}}];
